cases.title: State vs Ramesh Kadam
cases.text:
IN THE COURT OF THE SPECIAL JUDGE (NDPS), THANE
FIR No. 118/2026, Police Station Kasarvadavali, Thane. Date of FIR: 01-03-2026.
Sections: NDPS Act 20(b)(ii)(C), 29.
ACCUSED: Ramesh Kadam (fictional), age 34, driver, resident of Bhiwandi.
BRIEF FACTS: On 01-03-2026 at about 22:40 hrs, a naka-bandi team stopped a tempo near Ghodbunder Road. A search in the presence of two panch witnesses recovered a bag containing 1.2 kg of charas. The accused could not produce any licence or permit. Samples were drawn and sealed on the spot.
ARREST: Accused arrested on 02-03-2026 at 01:15 hrs. Grounds of arrest were given in writing.
EVIDENCE: Seizure panchnama; sealed sample; FSL request; mobile phone of accused.
WITNESSES: PSI S. Jadhav, two panch witnesses.
STATUS: Investigation incomplete. FSL report awaited. Charge sheet not yet filed. Custody continues beyond the statutory period; no extension order on record.

cases.title: State vs Anita Deshpande
cases.text:
IN THE COURT OF THE CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE, PUNE
FIR No. 207/2026, Economic Offences Wing, Pune. Date of FIR: 20-05-2026.
Sections: BNS 318(4), 336(3), 340(2), 61(2).
ACCUSED: Anita Deshpande (fictional), age 41, accountant. Co-accused: Vivek Marathe (fictional), released on bail.
BRIEF FACTS: The complainant firm alleges that between 01-10-2025 and 15-04-2026 the accused created forged vendor invoices and routed payments of Rs 48,00,000 to two accounts she controlled. Bank statements trace the funds to her relatives' accounts.
ARREST: 10-06-2026. Police custody for 5 days, then judicial custody.
EVIDENCE: Forged invoices; bank statements; forensic image of office computer; statements of three staff members.
WITNESSES: Firm director, two accounts staff, bank manager.
STATUS: Charge sheet filed on 02-08-2026. Cognizance pending. Prosecution states digital evidence may be tampered with if the accused is released.

cases.title: Directorate vs Sanjay Bhatia
cases.text:
PROSECUTION COMPLAINT, SPECIAL COURT (PMLA), MUMBAI
ECIR No. MBZO/14/2026. Predicate offence: FIR 331/2025, BNS 318(4).
Sections: PMLA 3, 4 (punishable under section 4).
ACCUSED: Sanjay Bhatia (fictional), age 52, promoter of a housing project company.
BRIEF FACTS: Investigation shows that about Rs 22,00,00,000 collected from 140 homebuyers was moved through five shell companies and used to buy land held in the names of the accused's family members. The accused is said to have been aware of and to have directed these transfers.
ARREST: 20-01-2026 by the Directorate. Remanded to judicial custody.
EVIDENCE: Bank records; statements recorded under section 50; attached land records; email correspondence.
WITNESSES: Company auditor, two bank officers, three homebuyers.
STATUS: Complaint filed on 15-03-2026. Cognizance taken. The accused states he has no prior case. The Directorate states there is a risk that records may be destroyed.

cases.title: State vs Pooja Nair and others
cases.special_laws: Dowry Prohibition Act 3; Dowry Prohibition Act 4
cases.text:
FIR No. 402/2026, Police Station Nashik Road. Date of FIR: 14-08-2026.
Sections: BNS 85, 115(2), 3(5); Dowry Prohibition Act 3, 4.
COMPLAINANT: Meena Nair (fictional), age 29.
ACCUSED NAMED: Husband Arjun Nair; mother-in-law Pooja Nair (fictional), age 58; sister-in-law Kavita Menon (fictional), age 31, resident of Pune.
BRIEF FACTS: The complainant alleges repeated demands for Rs 5,00,000 and a car after marriage on 12-02-2025, along with taunts and one incident of slapping on 02-08-2026. Allegations against the mother-in-law and sister-in-law are general, with no dates given for specific acts.
ARREST: None so far. Notice issued under BNSS 35 to the accused.
EVIDENCE: Complainant's statement; WhatsApp messages from the husband; medical certificate for minor injury.
STATUS: Investigation ongoing. Charge sheet not filed. Accused persons have applied for anticipatory bail and offered to join the investigation.

cases.title: State vs Imran Shaikh
cases.text:
FIR No. 566/2026, Police Station Sitabuldi, Nagpur. Date of FIR: 11-09-2026.
Sections: BNS 106(1); Motor Vehicles Act 185.
ACCUSED: Imran Shaikh (fictional), age 27, software engineer.
BRIEF FACTS: At about 23:10 hrs on 11-09-2026 the accused's car struck a motorcycle near Variety Square. The rider, Deepak Wankhede (fictional), died in hospital. The accused remained at the spot, called an ambulance and later gave a statement. Breath test recorded alcohol above the permitted limit.
ARREST: 12-09-2026 at 02:00 hrs.
EVIDENCE: CCTV footage; breath analyser report; vehicle inspection report; post-mortem report.
WITNESSES: Two eyewitnesses, traffic constable, treating doctor.
STATUS: Investigation ongoing. Charge sheet not filed. Family of the deceased has not opposed bail in writing.

cases.title: State vs Rohit Chauhan
cases.text:
FIR No. 88/2026, Cyber Crime Police Station, Gurugram. Date of FIR: 25-05-2026.
Sections: BNS 318(4), 319(2); IT Act 66C, 66D.
ACCUSED: Rohit Chauhan (fictional), age 30, resident of Jaipur, Rajasthan.
BRIEF FACTS: Between 20-05-2026 and 15-06-2026 sixty-three persons received calls and messages from numbers spoofed to look like a bank helpline. They were asked to share OTPs, and Rs 71,00,000 was debited from their accounts. The money moved through mule accounts to the accused.
ARREST: 18-07-2026 at Jaipur after a lookout notice.
EVIDENCE: Call records; seized phones and laptop; bank trail; statements of victims.
WITNESSES: Eleven victims, bank nodal officer, cyber forensic expert.
STATUS: Charge sheet filed on 10-09-2026. Accused has no fixed address in Haryana. Prosecution states two co-accused are absconding.

cases.title: State vs Sunil Patil and others
cases.text:
FIR No. 311/2026, Police Station Shahupuri, Kolhapur. Date of FIR: 03-10-2026.
Sections: BNS 115(2), 118(1), 189(2), 190, 191(2).
ACCUSED: Sunil Patil (fictional), age 46, farmer, and six others.
BRIEF FACTS: On 03-10-2026 around 17:30 hrs a quarrel over use of a village access road led to a clash between two groups armed with sticks. Four persons were injured, one with a fracture. Accused Sunil Patil is alleged to have struck the complainant with a stick.
ARREST: 05-10-2026. Produced before the Magistrate and remanded to judicial custody.
EVIDENCE: Medical reports of the injured; recovered sticks; statements of villagers.
WITNESSES: Four injured persons, six villagers.
STATUS: Investigation ongoing. Charge sheet not filed. The accused has produced medical papers showing diabetes requiring daily insulin and has applied for interim bail.

cases.title: State vs Mahesh Kulkarni
cases.special_laws: Prevention of Corruption Act 7; Prevention of Corruption Act 13(1)(d) r/w 13(2)
cases.text:
CHARGE SHEET, SPECIAL JUDGE (ANTI-CORRUPTION), PUNE
Case No. ACB/Pune/27/2026.
Sections: Prevention of Corruption Act 7; 13(1)(d) read with 13(2).
ACCUSED: Mahesh Kulkarni (fictional), age 38, Junior Engineer, Pune Municipal Corporation.
BRIEF FACTS: The complainant, a contractor, alleged that the accused demanded Rs 25,000 to clear a work bill. A verification was done on 20-04-2026. On 21-04-2026 a trap was laid and the accused was caught accepting tainted notes. Notes were recovered from his table drawer and the phenolphthalein test was positive.
ARREST: 22-04-2026.
EVIDENCE: Verification report; trap panchnama; recovered notes; audio recording of the demand; sanction order dated 25-06-2026.
WITNESSES: Complainant contractor, two independent panchas, ACB officers.
STATUS: Charge sheet filed on 10-07-2026. Prosecution opposes bail, stating the complainant continues to depend on the municipal office for work.

cases.title: State vs Ajay Yadav
cases.text:
FIR No. 640/2026, Police Station Hazratganj, Lucknow. Date of FIR: 09-05-2026.
Sections: BNS 309(4), 3(5); Arms Act 25(1)(a), 27.
ACCUSED: Ajay Yadav (fictional), age 29, resident of Barabanki. Two other accused named.
BRIEF FACTS: On 09-05-2026 at about 11:00 hrs three men entered a jewellery shop and threatened the owner with a pistol, taking gold ornaments worth Rs 9,00,000. They left on a motorcycle. The owner and one employee gave descriptions of the accused.
ARREST: 11-05-2026. A country-made pistol and part of the stolen gold were recovered on his pointing out.
EVIDENCE: Recovery memo; CCTV footage (partly unclear); test identification parade report; call detail records.
PRIOR CASES: Two earlier cases of theft registered in 2022 and 2024.
STATUS: Charge sheet filed on 02-08-2026. Two co-accused are still absconding. Shop owner reports receiving threatening calls.

cases.title: State vs Dinesh Rao
cases.text:
FIR No. 74/2024, Police Station Ulsoor, Bengaluru. Date of FIR: 10-02-2024.
Sections: IPC 302 read with 34.
ACCUSED: Dinesh Rao (fictional), age 33, auto driver. Main accused: Kiran Gowda (fictional), absconding at the time of charge sheet.
BRIEF FACTS: On 10-02-2024 an argument over a parking spot led to a fight outside a bar. Kiran Gowda is alleged to have stabbed the deceased, Naveen Shetty (fictional). Eyewitnesses state that Dinesh Rao held the deceased by the arms during the attack. Dinesh Rao is not alleged to have carried a weapon.
ARREST: 15-02-2024.
EVIDENCE: Post-mortem report; recovered knife (from main accused); CCTV footage; statements of five eyewitnesses.
WITNESSES: 21 listed.
STATUS: Charge sheet filed on 10-05-2024. Charges framed on 04-11-2024. Four witnesses examined to date; trial dates have been adjourned several times. Accused has been in custody since arrest. His earlier bail application was rejected in 2025.
